arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/leads-bootstrap-main-final.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test "$commit" = "58a206a6746e86ebcb8ed53f1fabbf9d45ff01a5"
echo VERIFIED_MAIN_SHA "$commit"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('AGENTS.md','docs/BOOTSTRAP.md','docs/PROJECT-STATE.md','docs/README.md','docs/PUBLIC_GROUP_DISCOVERY.md','docs/OPERATIONS_AND_REVIEW.md','docs/OWNER-PROTOCOL-20261019.md'):
 t=Path(name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 assert 'BOOTSTRAP.md' in t, name
 print('BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_PASS',name)
boot=Path('docs/BOOTSTRAP.md').read_text()
assert 'PT_ES' in boot and 'EU_OTHER' in boot
assert '(conta, grupo)' in boot
assert 'quota fixa' in boot
assert 'fonte' in boot
print('BOOTSTRAP_AS_SOURCE_PASS')
PY
sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
echo EXACT_MAIN_CERTIFIED
